description: This Java class 'InteropIdentifierRequestData' defines a data structure used for handling interoperation identifier requests, including validation and parsing logic for JSON input and associated parameters.

classes.name: InteropIdentifierRequestData
classes.description: A data class representing an interoperation identifier request, including fields for identifier type, value, sub-identifier or type, and account ID, with validation and parsing logic.

methods.name: getIdType
methods.description: Returns the type of the identifier, represented as an InteropIdentifierType.

methods.name: getIdValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the identifier as a string.

methods.name: getSubIdOrType
methods.description: Returns the sub-identifier or type as a string, if applicable.

methods.name: getAccountId
methods.description: Returns the associated account ID as a string.

methods.name: validateAndParse
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON object to produce an InteropIdentifierRequestData instance, performing parameter validation and handling unsupported fields.
